items.title: Fast-mcp-telegram Vulnerability Allow Attackers to Access Sensitive Files
items.description: A critical security flaw has been discovered in the fast-mcp-telegram package that could allow remote attackers to access sensitive Telegram session data and perform unauthorized actions. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-52830 , affects all versions up to 0.19.0 and has been fixed in version 0.19.1.
